title: EU source capability assessment
criteria: The issue decision gate permits field/well production OR usable field metadata. Monthly production fit, concession mapping and reuse are assessed separately. No source is automatically enrolled in an analysis chain.
catalog_status: Existing catalog and domain index were unavailable in the inspected checkout. Keys below identify assessment rows only; no catalog source or dataset identities are assigned.
evidence_retention: Publisher response bodies and headers are retained as local research evidence, outside the public repository. Digests identify those observed bytes, not redistributed source datasets or a backup. No raw CORES workbook was downloaded.

sources.title: Energy resource extraction sites (oil and gas)
sources.granularity: National, regional, provincial and marine-zone summaries; concession and well counts are not individual field records.
sources.access: Public page and linked downloads; no credentials requested for page inspection. Linked table payloads were not opened.
sources.temporal_coverage: The page states 1982 to November 2024; production tables describe 2023.
sources.spatial_coverage: Italy onshore and offshore marine zones.
sources.update_frequency: Annual indicator; factsheet dated 2024-12-31. No later update was shown at inspection.
sources.licence: No source-specific reuse terms established from the inspected indicator page.
sources.source_units: Page production summaries use Sm3 for gas and tonnes for oil; no conversion is performed.
sources.previous_decision: Coverage only in the earlier issue research.
sources.comparison: CONFIRMED for the ISPRA indicator; does not establish absence of granular data elsewhere in Italy.
limitations: The linked XLSX tables were not inspected internally.
Aggregate counts do not establish field or well identifiers, production histories, water depth or spud dates.
sources.next_step: Retain as coverage context; assess the upstream ministry source separately.

sources.title: Produzione nazionale di idrocarburi
sources.granularity: Mining title (concession), not an established one-to-one field or well key.
sources.access: Public production page and credential-free partial CSV request; server returned HTTP 206 for bytes 0-4095.
sources.temporal_coverage: Page advertises CSV years 2004-2026 and data through 2026-07-31, updated 2026-09-29. Coverage was not recomputed from the partial response.
sources.spatial_coverage: Italian onshore and offshore producing concessions.
sources.update_frequency: Monthly columns; publication cadence is not stated. Reporting resolution is distinct from refresh frequency.
sources.licence: The production page states Creative Commons Attribuzione 4.0 Internazionale and links CC BY 4.0.
sources.source_units: Gas: Sm3; crude oil and gasoline: kg, as stated on the production page. Reference conditions and conversion inputs remain unqualified.
sources.previous_decision: Italy was parked when only ISPRA was considered; the later issue research proposed promotion after discovering this source.
sources.comparison: CHANGED relative to the initial Italy park decision; current partial header confirms the later concession-series finding, with mapping still unresolved.
limitations: Only the CSV header and initial bytes were inspected; full-file completeness, duplicate rows, missing-month representation and annual-total reconciliation remain NOT_EVALUATED.
A concession is not assumed to be a field; its production cannot yet be allocated to fields.
No density, gas energy factor, fiscal assumptions, well depths or development costs are inferred.
sources.next_step: Prepare a concession-aware ingestion proposal with attribution, full-byte provenance, missing-month handling and an independently reviewed title-to-field mapping before field cashflow.

sources.title: Exploration history; Data/Consultation
sources.granularity: Narrative exploration events and well examples; no commercial per-field monthly production series or structured field input table on the inspected pages.
formats: facility-held technical records described on the consultation page
sources.access: Public narrative and consultation pages; underlying technical information is described as available at DGEG or LNEG facilities. No facility records or map layers were requested.
sources.temporal_coverage: Exploration narrative begins in 1938; the consultation page describes wells since 1938. The observation date is not a source vintage.
sources.update_frequency: Not stated on the inspected pages.
sources.licence: Footer reserves rights; no dataset reuse licence established. A linked price-list page was not opened.
sources.source_units: Narrative uses metres, seismic distances and test-recovery litres; these are not monthly commercial production volumes.
sources.comparison: CONFIRMED for the inspected pages. The history page states no current petroleum exploration/exploitation rights; a nationwide claim of no possible metadata is not made.
limitations: Isolated exploratory-well depths do not establish a structured producing-field input dataset.
Map-layer schemas and reuse permissions remain NOT_EVALUATED.
Production tests are not treated as a producing-field history, and absent production is not a zero-valued series.
sources.next_step: Retain exploration coverage; consider field-metadata promotion only after a usable structured dataset and reuse rights are established.

sources.title: Indigenous Crude Oil Production; Indigenous Natural Gas Production
sources.granularity: Per-field monthly structure was established by earlier issue research and is supported by existing parsers; current workbook internals were not opened in this check.
sources.access: Public statistics page links both workbooks; credential-free HEAD requests returned HTTP 200 and spreadsheet content types. HEAD responses do not establish workbook content.
sources.temporal_coverage: Current page lists oil series from 1966 and gas from 1963. The later issue research distinguishes annual early oil rows from monthly rows; exact current row coverage remains unverified.
sources.spatial_coverage: Spanish producing fields according to the earlier workbook characterization; the current portal labels the series indigenous production.
sources.update_frequency: Page update and workbook Last-Modified dates are 2026-10-13. Monthly reporting is historical evidence, not a new full workbook validation.
sources.licence: Legal notice requires prior written authorization for reproduction, transmission or modification; citation and latest-update conditions also apply. Attribution alone is not authorization.
sources.required_attribution: Source CORES (www.cores.es), with the latest update date when information refers to a specific date.
sources.source_units: Existing package and earlier issue research identify tonnes for oil and GWh for gas. Current workbook units remain unverified in this HEAD-only check; no conversion is performed.
sources.previous_decision: Promoted and already implemented in the Spain package; the later research corrected the reuse interpretation.
sources.comparison: CONFIRMED availability and reuse restriction; current field-level structure is UNVERIFIED. NOT_EVALUATED describes this check, not a reversal or removal of the existing chain.
limitations: No raw workbook or production series is redistributed in this change.
Current per-field headers, units, missing-data semantics and date coverage remain NOT_EVALUATED.
Neither raw data nor derived-data publication rights are inferred from public access; written authorization must cover the intended reuse.
sources.next_step: Reuse the existing chain after authorized local workbook inspection; preserve publisher attribution and update date, and obtain permission covering intended reproduction or publication.
